segments.text: 6 Therfore the rulers & theſe gouernours went together to the kyng and ſayd thus vnto hym: kyng Darius, liue for euer.

7 All ye rulers of thy kingdome, the officers and gouernours, the counſellers and dukes haue conſulted together to make a decree for the king, and
to eſtabliſhe a ſtatute, that who ſoeuer ſhall aſke a petition of any God or mā for thirty dayes ſaue of thee O kyng, hee ſhalbe caſt into the denne of Lyons.
